parts.official_mark_scheme_text: *M1: commence integration by parts to Ax²sin(x/3) ± ∫Bx sin(x/3)dx; BOD on sign, otherwise 0/6. A1: 3x²sin(x/3)−∫6x sin(x/3)dx. *DM1: complete a second integration by parts to Ax²sin(x/3)+Bx cos(x/3)+C sin(x/3). A1: 3x²sin(x/3)+18x cos(x/3)−54sin(x/3), OE. DM1: substitute limits correctly, dependent on both M marks, using sin(π/3)=√3/2 and cos(π/3)=1/2. A1: exact final answer, ISW. Alternative integration-by-parts ordering with the same primitive earns the same marks. [Total: 6]
